name: Houdini MCP: Graph Diff
description: Read the runtime's dirty-state ledger for the current workflow execution and return a structured diff (created / deleted / modified / cooked / connections_changed / flags_changed). Source of truth is scene_cache.get_dirty_nodes() — populated by the transaction node and by direct calls to houdini_runtime.execute_operation. No live Houdini queries are performed; this is fast even on large scenes. clear_after_read drains the ledger so the next diff starts fresh.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.scene_cache import get_scene_cache

class HouMCPGraphDiffNode(BaseNode):
    name = "Houdini MCP: Graph Diff"
    category = "Houdini"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.icon_path = "icons/houdini_icon.png"
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("clear_after_read", "bool", widget_type="bool", default=True)
        self.add_output("diff", "any")
        self.add_output("diff_json", "string")
        self.add_output("created", "list")
        self.add_output("deleted", "list")
        self.add_output("modified", "list")
        self.add_output("cooked", "list")
        self.add_output("connections_changed", "list")
        self.add_output("flags_changed", "list")
        self.add_output("total_changes", "int")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        cache = get_scene_cache()
        try:
            diff = cache.get_dirty_nodes()
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"graph_diff read failed: {exc}")
            empty = {"created": [], "deleted": [], "modified": [], "cooked": [], "connections_changed": [], "flags_changed": []}
            return {"diff": empty, "diff_json": json.dumps(empty), "created": [], "deleted": [], "modified": [], "cooked": [], "connections_changed": [], "flags_changed": [], "total_changes": 0, "exec_out": True}

        clear = bool(inputs.get("clear_after_read", True))
        if clear:
            try:
                cache.clear_dirty_state()
            except Exception as exc:
                self.log_error(f"clear_dirty_state failed: {exc}")

        total = sum(len(diff.get(k, [])) for k in ("created", "deleted", "modified", "cooked", "connections_changed", "flags_changed"))
        self.log_info(f"graph_diff: {total} change(s) since last read.")
        return {
            "diff": diff,
            "diff_json": json.dumps(diff, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str),
            "created": list(diff.get("created") or []),
            "deleted": list(diff.get("deleted") or []),
            "modified": list(diff.get("modified") or []),
            "cooked": list(diff.get("cooked") or []),
            "connections_changed": list(diff.get("connections_changed") or []),
            "flags_changed": list(diff.get("flags_changed") or []),
            "total_changes": total,
            "exec_out": True,
        }

def register_node():
    return HouMCPGraphDiffNode
